harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built and verified the four-node Prometheus/Thanos stack. Both Prometheus replicas collect all four hosts, node3 deduplicates them and serves object-backed history, and node4 provides authenticated TLS MinIO storage. Every node passed a sequential reboot and persistence test.
actions_performed: Installed node_exporter on all nodes and Prometheus on node1/node2.
Configured identical scrape topology with distinct replica labels and Thanos sidecars.
Configured Thanos Query, Store Gateway, and Compactor on node3.
Created the protected node3 credential environment file without exposing credentials.
Configured TLS MinIO on node4 with bucket thanos-metrics and persistent storage under /srv/thanos-objectstore.
Verified deduplication, both Prometheus failure directions, Store-only historical queries, and bucket integrity.
Restarted node1 through node4 individually and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Independent Prometheus replicas collect all four hosts
evidence.summary: Each post-restart replica is active with a healthy sidecar and exporter, four healthy host targets, zero upload failures, and listeners on 9090/10901/10902/9100.

evidence.requirement: Thanos Query, Store, and Compactor on node3 with replica deduplication
evidence.summary: Query returns four deduplicated series versus eight raw replica series; all three StoreAPI endpoints are healthy, ten blocks are loaded, and Query listens on node3:10902.

evidence.requirement: Authenticated HTTPS object store on node4:9000 with persistent bucket data
evidence.summary: TLS health succeeds, anonymous bucket access is disabled and returns 403, and thanos-metrics contains 36 objects including 12 block metadata objects under /srv/thanos-objectstore.
/root/thanos-objectstore.env persists with mode 600 and contains the required MinIO, AWS-compatible, endpoint, and bucket variable names; values were not exposed.

evidence.requirement: Queries survive loss of either Prometheus replica and retain history
evidence.summary: During separate node1 and node2 outages, node3 still returned all four hosts. During the node2 outage, a Store-gateway-only historical query also returned all four hosts; both replicas were restored afterward.
Sidecar blocks were present in MinIO, Thanos verification found no overlap or known index issues, and verification plus live and historical queries succeeded after MinIO restarted.
Captured healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered services and TSDB data, then confirmed both replicas and all StoreAPI members were healthy.
Captured healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered services and TSDB blocks, then confirmed complete cluster membership.
Captured healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered Query, Store, Compactor, credentials, deduplication, and Store-only history.
Captured healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered MinIO/TLS/exporter, retained and grew bucket data, and confirmed downstream Thanos reconnection.
